verses.text: Axo Jesús ix ik'jib'at yuj Yespíritu Dios t'a takinh lu'um. Ix k'och ta' yik tz'ak'ji prowal yuj winh diablo.
40 k'ual majxo walaj Jesús chi', ichato chi' ix och swejel.
Axo winh diablo ix k'och yak'lan smontanb'at t'a chukal, ix yalan winh: --Ina Yuninal ach Dios, al t'a juntzanh k'een tik yik tz'och k'een panil, xchi winh t'ay.
Palta ix yalan Jesús: --Ha t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani, a tz'alan icha tik: Manh yujoknhej tas swaji ay ko k 'inal. Palta yuj jantaknhej tas syal Dios ay ko k 'inal, xchikani, xchi Jesús.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ik'jib'at yuj winh diablo chi' t'a jun chonhab' yiknhej Dios yaji, haton Jerusalén. Ix yik'ank'e Jesús chi' winh t'a schon stemplo Dios.

Ix yalan winh t'ay icha tik: --Ina Yuninal ach Dios, emanh chennaj t'a sat lu'um chi', yujto syalkan t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani: Ol yal Dios t'a heb' yángel, yik tzach stanhwej heb'. Ol ach ketzchajk'e yuj heb', yik wach' manh ol a tenoch ok t'a k'een k'een, xchikani, xchi winh diablo chi'.
Ix tak'wi pax Jesús chi': --Palta syalpax icha tik t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani: Manh in eyak' prowal, yujto he Yajal in, he Diosal in, xchikani, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yik'anxib'at Jesús chi' winh diablo, ix k'och heb' t'a jun niwan tzalan. Ix sch'oxan masanil nakión winh t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik t'ay. Ix sch'oxan winh to te niwan yelk'och swach'il.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh: --Masanil juntzanh tik, ol wak' ikej, tato tzach em kuman t'ayin, tzalan a b'a t'ayin, xchi winh.

Palta ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Ach Satanás, elanh t'a in tz'ey. Yujto icha tik syal t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani: Ha t'ayin tzeyal he b'a, yujto he Yajal in, he Diosal in. Ha innhej tzin eyak' serwil, xchi Dios, xchi Jesús chi'.
Yuj chi', ix aktajkan Jesús chi' yuj winh. Axo heb' ángel ix ul ak'an serwil.
Axo yik ix yab'an Jesús to preso yaj winhaj Juan, ix b'atxi t'a yol yik Galilea.

Manhok t'a Nazaret ix k'ochi, palta ha t'a Capernaum, ata' ix k'och kajan. Ha jun chonhab' chi', ha t'a sti' ha' nhajab' ay. Ha t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal winhaj Zabulón yet' winhaj Neftalí, ata' ay.
Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj winhaj Isaías schekab' Dios t'a peka', xchi icha tik:
Ha t'a yol yik Zabulón yet' t'a yol yik Neftalí, ha t'a sti' ha' nhajab' ata' ay, t'a sk'axepalek' ha' niwan Jordán. Ata' ay jun chonhab' Galilea sb'i, haton b'aj kajan heb' manh israelok.

Ha heb' anima chi', ayto ek' heb' t'a k'ik' k'inal, palta ol yil jun sakil k'inal heb' te niwan yelk'ochi. Ha heb' ayek' ta', ichato chamnak heb', palta ol k'och sakil k'inal t'a heb', xchi t'a Slolonel Dios chi'.
Axo yik ix k'och Jesús chi' ta', ix och ijan yalanel slolonel Dios t'a heb' anima chi', ix yalan icha tik: --Naek he b'a, yujto toxo ol wach' och Dios aj satcha'anh Yajalil, xchi t'a heb'.

Ayik wan sb'eyek' Jesús t'a sti' ha' nhajab' yik Galilea, ix yilani ayek' winhaj Simón skuch pax Pedro yet' jun winh yuk'tak winh skuchan Andrés. Wan yak'anem jun schimpa heb' winh yik yamlab' chay t'a yol ha', yujto yamum chay heb' winh.
Axo Jesús ix alan t'a heb' winh: --Ochanhek in k'ayb'umok. Ol wak'och eyopisio. Icha tzeyutej eyaman nok' chay tik, icha chi' ol eyutok eyik'ankot heb' anima t'ayin, xchi t'a heb' winh.
T'a jun rato chi' ix yaktejkan ch'anh schimpa heb' winh. Ix och heb' winh sk'ayb'umok Jesús chi'.

Janik'anto sb'at heb', ix ilchaj chawanhxo heb' winh yuk'tak sb'a yuj, haton winhaj Jacobo yet' winhaj Juan. Ha winhaj Zebedeo ay yik heb' winh. Ayoch heb' winh t'a yol jun barko yet' smam chi', wan snipan schimpa heb' winh yik yamlab' chay. Axo Jesús ix awtankot heb' winh.
T'a jun rato chi' ix yaktankan smam heb' winh chi' yet' jun barko chi', ix och heb' winh sk'ayb'umok Jesús.

Ix ek' Jesús t'a yol yik Galilea chi' yet' heb' sk'ayb'um. Ix laj ek' sk'ayb'ej heb' anima t'a yoltak spatil skulto. Ix ek' yalanel jun wach' ab'ix, chajtil tz'aj yoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios aj satcha'anh. Jantaknhej juntzanh yab'il tz'ik'an heb' anima chi', ix laj b'oxikan heb' yuj.

Ix laj pukaxel yab'ixal Jesús t'a skal masanil yol yik Siria. Yuj chi' ix ik'jib'at heb' penaay smasanil t'ay, jantaknhej juntzanh yab'il yet' juntzanh ilya tz'ik'an heb'. Anhejtona', ay pax heb' tz'ixtaj yuj heb' enemigo, heb' skot t'a sjolom yet' heb' sikb'inakeli. Ix laj ik'jib'at heb' t'ay. Yuj chi' ix b'oxikan heb' smasanil yuj.

Jantak heb' aj Galilea chi', ix laj och tzak'an heb' yuj. Anhejtona', ay heb' t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Decápolis, t'a Jerusalén, t'a Judea yet' pax t'a sk'axepalek' ha' niwan Jordán, ix laj och pax tzak'an heb' yuj.
